problem: Native Excel chart evidence had no permanent owner semantic regressions across the BIFF8, XLSX and XLSB fixtures. Native traversal and source edits exposed four defects hidden by synthetic chart scaffolds.
changes: Read/write four-byte Radar and RadarArea records in both XLS and shared OGraph codecs, ignoring reserved bits and unused bytes per MS-XLS 2.4.212/213 and MS-OGRAPH 2.4.81/82.
Locate the unique source-checked Chart payload after the valid native BIFF host prelude, retaining all other bytes during fixed-width geometry edits.

Load and validate classic XLSX chart-sheet style/color companions through their implicit 2011/2012 relationship bindings, with internal path, content type, XML root, leaf and byte/count bounds; unrelated relationships still require explicit XML references.
Replay payload-only XLSX chart patches in place when content type and typed relationships are unchanged, preserving source relationship serialization during inverse application.
Add eleven native integration tests and three codec regressions, and index seven additional feature rows with explicit partial-scope limits.

verification_scope.xlsx_xlsb_families: All 17 embedded classic chart families across 18 worksheets: group and axis counts; stable series indices, title references, source formulas, categories and numeric caches; XY/bubble values; stock date serials and high/low/close caches; combo grouping; error-bar types/values and linear trendline metadata. DrawingSVG has no chart. No recalculation or renderer is invoked.
verification_scope.chart_sheets: Sales chart contains three series (Quantity, Unit price, Total) and four named categories. PivotChart007 retains the native pivot source workbook prefix, format ID 1 and saved North/Gadget value 9.5. XLSX additionally resolves the source to the typed PivotTable1. BIFF retains the Grand Total point alongside North; the OOXML cache contains only North. BIFF pivot-link records remain opaque.
verification_scope.source_edits: Native XLS cache edit changes exactly one cached NUMBER record and Radar geometry edit changes exactly one Chart record; all other BIFF records and CFB streams remain intact, and exact inverses restore the source. Native XLSX cached-value replacement changes only chart1.xml and the inverse restores every member including its original companion .rels bytes. Native XLSB cell B2 changes while saved chart caches, chart XML, styles/colors and relationships remain inert and byte-identical; the inverse restores the original package.
verification_scope.companion_validation: Native style1.xml/colors1.xml resources and relationship IDs retained exactly. Typed validation rejects wrong content type/root/path, external companion and unrelated unreferenced relationship; both 2011 native and 2012 normative spellings accepted.
verification_scope.radar_wire: Both Radar and RadarArea reject lengths 0, 2, 3 and 5; four defined flag combinations ignore the high fourteen bits and final two bytes, and serialization emits four bytes with zeroed unused bytes.
verification_scope.limits: No fresh Office reopen, chart rendering, formula evaluation, pivot refresh, macro execution or external access. No complete chart lifecycle or modern ChartEx qualification.
